echo "=== analyze variance ==="

find /tmp/data -name "*.md" | sort

find /tmp/data -iname "*findings*" -exec head -40 {} \;

echo "=== dispute --detector D0 ==="
python3 -m fin.cli dispute --detector D0 --out /tmp/data/dispute.csv
cat /tmp/data/dispute.csv
stat -c '"'"'%a'"'"' /tmp/data/dispute.csv'
